usage: After operator review, save as csv_records.py. Requires Python 3, standard library only. Run: python3 csv_records.py < input.json. Input is one JSON object containing text and delimiter (comma, semicolon, or tab). Alternatively, import convert_csv and pass that object. Returns records or {"error":"invalid_input"}; malformed CSV, duplicate headers, and inconsistent row widths invalidate the entire input. Preserves Unicode, whitespace, empty strings, and quoted embedded newlines. Empty input returns an empty records list; header-only input also returns an empty list. Empty header names are allowed if unique; blank rows fail width validation. Source has not been executed.
